primary.title: Gold has delivered 23% returns since 2019: Why investors should factor in inflation when estimating future returns
primary.summary: Gold has delivered strong returns in recent years, but its long-term history shows that investors may also face extended periods of subdued performance. Here’s what the latest data suggests about gold’s return potential and how investors can estimate long-term returns by factoring in inflation.
